briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and official sources, including PIB Fact Check, have consistently debunked claims that Prime Minister Modi is offering 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indians. These claims, often circulated on social media platforms like WhatsApp and Facebook, are frequently associated with phishing scams designed to collect personal information. NewsMobile reported on November 16, 2025, that a video circulating after the Bihar Assembly elections claiming a free recharge offer was a misleading phishing scam using an AI-generated video of PM Modi. Hindustan Times reported on June 7, 2024, that similar claims following the 2024 elections were fake, with PIB clarifying no such scheme exists. The government has explicitly stated that neither the Prime Minister nor the Indian government has announced or is running any such scheme.
